newsitem.title: USA: Duquesne again pushes back Pa. nuke restart.
newsitem.headline: Duquesne again pushes back Pa. nuke restart.

text.p: Duquesne Light Co said Tuesday it again pushed back the restart of its 833 megawatt (MW) Beaver Valley 2 nuclear power plant since it was shut August 30 for refueling and maintenance.
"Our target date for being back on line with Beaver Valley 2 is December 1," said Duquesne spokesman Dennis O'Neil.

The startup of the Beaver Valley unit in Shippingport, Pa., was previously delayed to mid-November from an original date of October 14. The company had needed more time to repair a leaking residual heat removal pump.
O'Neil did not give a reason for the latest postponement.
The adjoining unit, Beaver Valley 1 (810 MW), was running at full output.
